summary_en: Tender offer price raised to ¥1,260/share from ¥1,220/share. Terra acquiring Satudora Holdings with goal of taking company private. Commitment pledges received from four shareholders totalling 3,433,300 shares (24.91% of S/O) to tender at revised price. Offer commenced 22 June 2026.
title_en: Notice of Revision to Announcement of Commencement of Tender Offer for Ordinary Shares of Satudora Holdings Co., Ltd. (Securities Code: 3544) accompanying Submission of Amended Tender Offer Report by Terra Co., Ltd.
translation_en_brief:
This notice, filed 17 July 2026 by Terra Co., Ltd., announces revisions to the tender offer for Satudora Holdings (ticker 3544, listed on TSE Standard and Sapporo Securities Exchange). The tender offer began 22 June 2026 with the stated goal of taking the company private (非公開化).

Terra has increased the tender offer price from ¥1,220 per share to ¥1,260 per share. Concurrently, Terra has received commitment pledges from four shareholders—Seiji Hirooka (914,300 shares, 6.63% S/O), Maki Yonehara (831,800 shares, 6.04% S/O), MigenShoku Co., Ltd. (1,191,000 shares, 8.64% S/O), and Aozora Shoji Co., Ltd. (496,200 shares, 3.60% S/O)—accounting for a combined 3,433,300 shares (24.91% S/O). Each pledging shareholder has committed to tender all their shares at the revised price and not to cancel the resulting purchase contract.

The price revision and commitment pledges required Terra to amend the tender offer statement originally filed 22 June 2026. The revised announcement supersedes the prior notice dated 19 June 2026.
